limits: Speaking NPC count is speaking identifiers, not a final unique-person census; aliases and repeated source characters across works still need canonical reconciliation.
Sampling is not exhaustive path proof.
Three states require three actual image files within one age/appearance, not three age-only portraits.
Dedicated identity ownership is checked across every sampled named actor. Only explicitly declared canonicalIdentity aliases are coalesced; other IDs remain separate.
Quantities do not prove literary quality, causal weight, visual quality, human reading time, or external acceptance.
